APPROVE
The extracted `NestRoute` carries the guard checks, the body-span ternary and the nested decision ternaries out of the triple-nested loop, which drops `Nest` to about 13 by my count; the `continue`/`k = methodEnd - 1` flow and the reordered side-effect-free `classGuard ||` check keep behaviour identical, and the code compiles provided `Judged` is a reference type, which I couldn't confirm because the source isn't available here.
